items.heading: A Platform's Marketing, Pricing Page,
items.text: A Platform's Marketing, Pricing Page, A Platform's Marketing, Pricing Page, A platform's marketing, pricing page, and testimonials tell you about the business. They tell you very little about whether the specific person on your call is actually good at this. These four checks are about the person.

items.heading: Breadth of Experience Across Different
items.text: Breadth of Experience Across Different Breadth of experience across different life stages usually matters more than raw years in practice.

items.heading: Not Every Conversation Adds
items.text: Not every conversation adds the same thing. This is the difference a genuinely well-matched counsellor points toward.

visuals.heading: Ask About Real Training

items.heading: Ask About Real Training
items.text: Ask about real training and background directly. A specific answer is a stronger signal than a general "our counsellors are certified" line.

items.heading: Personalized Advice References Your Actual
items.text: Personalized advice references your actual profile in the reasoning itself, not just in a greeting line.

items.heading: A Counsellor Who Admits When
items.text: A counsellor who admits when something is outside their expertise is more trustworthy than one who has an opinion on everything.
